label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (ssrf) is alert-TP. User input 'param' flows to 'endpoint', which is used to construct a URL ('http://' + endpoint + '/v1') and open a connection. Although there is a check 'if (octets[0] == 127)', it only blocks loopback addresses. An attacker can supply an IP address like '169.254.169.254' (Cloud Metadata Service) or private ranges (10.x.x.x) which pass the check but allow access to internal resources. The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled.

evidence.note: User input flows to endpoint, DNS resolution occurs, weak loopback check allows non-127 IPs, connection opens with attacker-controlled endpoint.
